== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Shai is the youngest sister of [[Alin]]. A fourteen-year-old with a tendency toward a bored or detached expression, she often masks intense interest behind a flat gaze. She possesses a curious and inquisitive nature, frequently exploring her surroundings to touch and examine new objects, such as dismantling clockwork mechanisms or collecting various trinkets. Her history includes navigating her way into the barracks of the [[Tartarus Travelers]] and expressing curiosity regarding geological phenomena like melting rock. While she initially appeared to adapt easily to life in [[Enosh]], her status eventually shifts as she becomes an [[Elysian Traveler]]. In this capacity, she wears a white-and-gold uniform and demonstrates the ability to open a [[Gate to Elysia]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Shai is a fourteen-year-old girl who wears a uniform colored in white and gold. She is also associated with a pile of clockwork.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As the youngest sister of [[Alin]], she serves as his companion.}}
